heroHeadline: 23 Right Whale Calves — Best in 15 Years — as Trump Backs Protection Delay to 2035
heroSubtitle: The 2025–2026 North Atlantic Right Whale calving season confirmed 23 calves, the highest count since 2009, even as the Trump administration backed legislation to extend a moratorium on new fishing regulations until 2035. The Ocean Cleanup crossed 50 million kg of plastic removed in March 2026 and deployed its first Philippines river Interceptor in May. A new peer-reviewed study warned that 70% of Caribbean coral reefs shifted from growth to net erosion years ahead of predictions following the 2023–24 marine heatwave.
footerNote: Data sourced from NOAA, UNEP, The Ocean Cleanup, IUCN, Australian Institute of Marine Science, High Seas Alliance, UN BBNJ Agreement, and major scientific institutions. Coordinates verified against NOAA and OpenStreetMap references.
